findings.title: REQ-SDK-007 traceability row disagrees between requirements.md and tasks.md
findings.where: requirements.md § 'Requirement → task → test traceability' (REQ-SDK-007 row) vs tasks.md § 'Coverage matrix'
findings.problem: requirements.md maps REQ-SDK-007 to 'T3, T5, T7' but tasks.md maps it to 'T3, T7'. T5 is Incremental synchronization (REQ-SDK-004 only) and carries no validation/error responsibility, so its appearance in the requirements row is a stray cross-reference. Does not create ambiguity about what gets built; the per-task requirement tags and the tasks.md matrix are self-consistent.
findings.fix: In requirements.md, change the REQ-SDK-007 traceability row from 'T3, T5, T7' to 'T3, T7' to match the tasks.md coverage matrix and the T5 requirement tag.

findings.title: REQ-SDK-006 intro prose still says 'state-vector request' (stale after StateVectorRequest -> StateVector rename)
findings.problem: The intro describes 'a kind discriminator (full-state vs differential vs state-vector request)'. 'request' is residual wording from the renamed StateVectorRequest type, and the phrasing implies one kind field spanning three values whereas the contract (correctly defined in AC-SDK-006-1) splits across two types: TransportUpdate.kind: 'full' | 'diff' and StateVector.kind: 'stateVector'. The acceptance criterion itself is precise; only the prose is loose.
findings.fix: Reword the intro to: '... and a kind discriminator — "full" or "diff" on a TransportUpdate, "stateVector" on a StateVector', dropping the word 'request'.
